title: Maqtanchoq Jimi — Haqiqiy kuch amalda
rasmUslub: consistent clean 2D children's storybook line art, hand-drawn black outlines, soft flat pastel colors, warm sunlight, expressive friendly faces, simple park backgrounds, polished animation storyboard illustration, vertical 9:16 composition. Character consistency: Jimi is a young boy with spiky dark hair, yellow T-shirt, blue shorts and red sneakers. His friend is a young boy with round glasses and a green hoodie. Keep the same character designs, clothing, proportions and colors in every image. No text, no letters, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

scenes.subtitle: Haqiqiy kuch amalda bilinadi
scenes.ovoz: Jimi o‘zini dunyodagi eng kuchli bola deb bilardi. U har kuni do‘stlariga qanchalik kuchli va chaqqon ekanini aytardi.
scenes.rasm: Jimi, a cheerful young boy with spiky dark hair, yellow T-shirt, blue shorts and red sneakers, stands proudly in a sunny green park with hands on hips, smiling confidently. A few children play in the background. Wide friendly establishing shot.

scenes.ovoz: — Men hammadan kuchliman! Istagan ishni bir o‘zim uddalayman! — deb maqtanardi Jimi. Do‘stlari esa indamay tinglashardi.
scenes.rasm: In the same sunny park, Jimi in his yellow T-shirt, blue shorts and red sneakers points proudly at himself while boasting to two children. His expression is overconfident; the children look at him politely but unconvinced. Medium shot.

scenes.ovoz: Bir kuni bolalar rang-barang varrak uchirishdi. Birdan shamol kuchaydi va qizil-sariq varrak baland daraxt shoxiga ilinib qoldi.
scenes.rasm: A bright red-and-yellow diamond kite is stuck high in the branches of a leafy tree in the sunny park. Jimi and his friend with round glasses and a green hoodie look up at it. The kite string hangs down. Clear vertical composition.

scenes.ovoz: Jimi darrov: — Buni men olaman! — dedi. U daraxtga chiqishga urindi, ammo shoshilib oyog‘i sirpanib, yumshoq maysaga yiqildi.
scenes.rasm: Jimi, same spiky dark hair, yellow T-shirt, blue shorts and red sneakers, has slipped and landed safely on the soft green grass beneath the tree. He looks embarrassed and surprised, not hurt. The kite remains stuck above.

scenes.ovoz: Shunda ko‘zoynakli, yashil hudili do‘sti oldinga chiqdi. U uzun tayoq topib, ehtiyotkorlik bilan varrakni shoxdan tushirdi.
scenes.rasm: Jimi's friend, a young boy with round glasses and a green hoodie, carefully uses a long fallen branch to lift the red-and-yellow kite from the tree. Jimi watches from nearby, surprised. Safe, gentle action, full-body view.

scenes.ovoz: Jimi do‘stiga hayrat bilan qaradi. U ko‘p gapirmagan, lekin kerak paytda yordam bergan edi. Jimi o‘zining maqtanchoqligini tushuna boshladi.
scenes.rasm: Close medium shot of Jimi, same yellow T-shirt and spiky dark hair, looking thoughtful and humbled. His friend in the green hoodie and round glasses stands beside him holding the rescued kite. Warm gentle sunlight, expressive faces.

scenes.ovoz: — Rahmat, do‘stim. Men seni mensimay qo‘ygan ekanman. Kechir, — dedi Jimi. Do‘sti kulib, qo‘lini uzatdi. Ikkalasi qo‘l berib ko‘rishdi.
scenes.rasm: Jimi in yellow and his friend in green hoodie with round glasses smile and shake hands warmly under the tree. The rescued red-and-yellow kite is safely held between them. Friendship and forgiveness, medium shot.

scenes.subtitle: Kamroq maqtan, ko‘proq yaxshilik qil
scenes.ovoz: Bolalar yana birga varrak uchirishdi. O‘sha kundan boshlab Jimi kamroq maqtanadigan, ko‘proq ish qiladigan bo‘ldi. Chunki u bir narsani anglab yetdi: haqiqiy kuch gapda emas, amalda!
scenes.rasm: Happy ending in the same sunny park: Jimi in yellow, his friend in a green hoodie and two other children run together while flying the red-and-yellow kite high in the blue sky. Everyone is smiling. Joyful wide shot, uplifting children's storybook ending.
